positionSide.description: Position side Default net for One-way Mode long or short for Hedge Mode. It must be sent in Hedge Mode.

orderType.description: Order type market : market order limit : limit order post_only : Post-only order fok : Fill-or-kill order ioc : Immediate-or-cancel order

price.description: Order price. Not applicable to market

size.description: Number of contracts to buy or sell. For contract size details, refer to the /api/v1/market/instruments endpoint

reduceOnly.description: Whether orders can only reduce in position size. Valid options: true or false . The default value is false . Not supported under Hedge Mode and ignored if passed.

clientOrderId.description: Client Order ID as assigned by the client A combination of case-sensitive alphanumerics, all numbers, or all letters of up to 32 characters.

tpTriggerPrice.description: Take-profit trigger price If you fill in this parameter, you should fill in the tpOrderPrice as well.

tpOrderPrice.description: Take-profit order price. If you fill in this parameter, you should fill in the tpTriggerPrice as well. If the price is -1, take-profit will be executed at the market price.

tpTriggerPriceType.description: Take-profit trigger price type last : last price mark : mark price index : index price The default is last .

slTriggerPrice.description: Stop-loss trigger price If you fill in this parameter, you should fill in the slOrderPrice as well.

slOrderPrice.description: Stop-loss order price. If you fill in this parameter, you should fill in the slTriggerPrice as well. If the price is -1, stop-loss will be executed at the market price.
